messages.敵のマイナス効果の数で火力が伸びる貫通アタッカー。マイナス効果を盛った敵に撃つS: A Pierce attacker whose damage scales with the number of negative effects on his target. Against a heavily debuffed enemy, S2 Sanguine Pointillism becomes a major attack through its chain of Coin reuses.
messages.S2「血点描画」: Ⅰコイン的中時に20/40%の確率でコインを1回再使用し、対: **S2 — Sanguine Pointillism**: On hit, Coin Ⅰ has a 20%/40% chance to reuse itself, increased by 20 percentage points per negative effect on the target, up to 2 reuses per skill. Each hit adds 1 Bleed Count and inflicts 2/3 Count of a random negative effect. Inflicting a new type of negative effect may improve the chance of the next reuse. Slash-separated values indicate different Uptie tiers.
messages.S3「滴血の彩色」: Ⅳコインは対象のマイナス効果1つにつき与ダメージ量+15/: **S3 — Hematic Coloring**: Coin Ⅳ deals +15%/25% damage per negative effect on the target, up to +75%/125%. Coins Ⅱ and Ⅲ inflict more Bleed Count and Potency if the target has at least 4/3 negative effects.
messages.ランダムな状態異常と「血点描派」: S1〜S3の一部のコインで火傷・出血・振動・: **Random ailments and Sanguine Pointillist**: Certain Coins on S1–S3 randomly inflict Burn, Bleed, Tremor, Rupture, or Sinking. However, his always-active Sanguine Pointillist passive makes him count only as an Identity that inflicts Bleed.
messages.バトルパッシブ「課題評価」(色欲×4・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 的中時、対象の出: **Combat passive — Assignment Evaluation (4 Lust Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: On hit against a target with at least 6/4 Bleed Potency, restores 2 SP, plus 1 per negative effect on the target, up to 3 additional SP. If his SP is at its maximum when this recovery occurs, gains 1/2 Offense Level Up next turn. Activates up to 4 times per turn.
messages.サポートパッシブ「美学見習い」(色欲×4・保有・同期化Ⅲで取得): 精神力が最も: **Support passive — Practices on Aesthetics (4 Lust Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ)**: When the ally with the lowest SP hits, they recover 2 SP per negative effect on the target, up to 6, plus another 3 if the target has Bleed. Activates up to 2 times per turn.
messages.S1・S3で出血と複数種のマイナス効果を敵に重ね、数が揃ったところでS2を撃って: Use S1 and S3 to build Bleed and several different negative effects, then use S2 to chain its Coin reuses. Coin Ⅳ of S3 also scales sharply with the number of negative effects, giving him another strong attack against debuffed targets. At 6/4 Bleed Potency on the target, Assignment Evaluation sustains his SP and grants Offense Level Up if he is at maximum SP. He can supply several ailments alone, but allies who add further debuffs improve his performance. Focused Encounters make it easier to keep those effects on one enemy, and Ring teams help supply multiple debuffs. Early on, S2's relatively high minimum roll helps him win Clashes.
